about_the_game:
About This Game

Take the stress out of running your tabletop adventures.
This digital DM screen puts every essential tool at your fingertips, letting you focus on storytelling while the app handles the details. Whether you’re running Dungeons & Dragons, Pathfinder, or another TTRPG, this toolkit keeps your sessions organized and flowing smoothly.

Features

  • Initiative Tracker – Quickly manage turn order in combat.

  • Party Manager – Keep character sheets, stats, and inventories in one place.

  • NPC Generator – Create unique characters on the fly.

  • Shop Generator – Stock shops instantly with fitting items.

  • Weather Tool – Add dynamic conditions to shape the world.

  • Session Viewer – Keep story notes, from any source, ready to reference.

  • Mirror Display – Display your digital tabletop on your screen.

  • Sound Board – Trigger music or effects to set the mood.

  • Notes Section – Organize plot hooks, lore, and reminders.

  • Dice Roller – Roll virtual dice for any system.

Why Use It?

No more juggling notebooks, tabs, and random apps—this is your all-in-one command center for running smooth, immersive campaigns.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core (any Intel i3/AMD equivalent or better)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any integrated graphics card that supports basic hardware acceleration
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard audio
